question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

I do not object to this (__**accolade**__) on the grounds that Edinburgh has little literary tradition.
solution:
The correct answer is "Praise."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"****accolade****"** means a comment, prize, etc. that you receive that shows people’s high opinion of something that you have done. (उपलब्धि पर समाज से मिलने वाली प्रशंसा, पुरस्‍कार आदि)

 
 
• Example: *Her approval was the highest **accolade**__ he could receive.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence is "Praise."
 
• The word "praise" means what you say when you are expressing admiration for somebody/something. (प्रशंसा, सराहना (के शब्‍द))
 __
 
• Example:* The survivors were full of **praise**__ for the paramedics.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Criticism: **(an expression of) what you think is bad about somebody/something. (आलोचना, निंदा, दोषन्‍वेषण)
 
• **Indictment: **something that shows how bad something is. (किसी की दुर्दशा-ग्रस्‍तता का सूचक)
 
• **Stubborn: **not wanting to do what other people want you to do; refusing to change your plans or decisions. (दूसरों की बात न मानने वाला हठी, ज़िद्दी; अपनी (बातों, योजनाओं और फ़ैसलों) पर अड़ने वाला; अड़ियल)
